- memory_id "1000482": As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz holds the Atlas team pager instead of Priya Raman.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000001": The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000476" [decision]: As of 2025-06-19, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team and Priya Raman is no longer the primary on-call.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000281": Team Dune observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: team Dune, the cache change, notification service)

- memory_id "1000279" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
